nodes.label: for…of default loop
nodes.rationale: Works on every iterable, supports break/continue/return and await. Get the index via entries().

nodes.label: forEach cannot break or await
nodes.rationale: return exits the callback only. Async forEach ignores the returned promise — silent race. Use for…of or Promise.all(map).

nodes.label: for…in walks prototypes and stringifies indices
nodes.rationale: Includes inherited enumerable keys; array indices arrive as strings so i+1 concatenates. Prefer Object.keys and for…of.

nodes.label: let fresh binding per iteration
nodes.rationale: var is one shared binding (timers log 3 3 3). let creates a fresh binding per iteration so closures capture their own value.

nodes.label: do…while cursor pagination
nodes.rationale: Body runs at least once — fetch a page before you know whether a next cursor exists.
